report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0012, p95 74ms, zero dependency timeouts, INFO 200 logs. Only one ERROR span (gateway call inventory, 1003ms) appears, and topology shows gateway reaches inventory via order, so the failing hop is not established. No evidence supports any bounded root cause; hand off for downstream telemetry.
missing_evidence: Traces for order, inventory, payment, and postgresql services during the alert window to locate the failing hop
Inventory service metrics (error rate, p95 latency, redis timeout counts) to test redis-timeout or downstream-latency
Order service metrics and logs to test db-pool-exhaustion against postgresql
Gateway error-rate and p95 metrics over a longer window to confirm the alert is real and sustained
